cohort: 128 pregnancies in 99 women with heart disease, managed by a pregnancy heart team between 2012-2017 and ending in births after 24 weeks' gestation
finding: Vaginal birth is a suitable option for women with heart disease, given that pregnancies are managed and mode of birth is meticulously planned by a multidisciplinary pregnancy heart team.
mod_finding: Overall mode of birth was vaginal in 75% and cesarean section in 25%.
